jobs.description:
Position Title:

Director of Digital Products, Ad Experiences and Audience Activation (Hybrid/Telework)

Status of Employment:

Permanent

Position Language Requirement:

English, French

Language Skills:

English (Reading - C - Advanced), English (Speaking - C - Advanced), English (Writing - B - Intermediate), French (Reading - C - Advanced), French (Speaking - C - Advanced), French (Writing - B - Intermediate)

Work at CBC/Radio-Canada

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance.

Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.

Unposting Date:

2026-11-01 11:59 PM

This is a hybrid role with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

Job Overview:

This position is part of the Digital Media department, which oversees CBC and Radio-Canada’s flagship digital products.

In partnership with the Media Solutions division, the person in this role plays a key role in shaping the vision for CBC-RC monetization experience evolution. They leverage a deep understanding of digital, user behaviours, market trends, and technology to inform strategic thinking and guide product direction. They also will support the day to day audience segmentation activities and support and inform the monetization data strategy and roadmaps.

They lead the monetization products evolution — from testing to discovery to delivery — balancing user needs with business objectives. They work to enhance the overall experience and drive innovation to retain current clients, audiences and attract new ones. They also ensure the continuous evolution of tools and solutions that support Media Solutions and Marketing team operations as it relates to audience segmentation.

They collaborate with product managers to coordinate the work carried out by the product teams. They maintain strong ties with the sales, marketing, communications, and ad tech teams to ensure strategic and operational alignment.

This role also aims to create synergies across products to strengthen engagement within Radio-Canada’s broader digital ecosystem. The individual actively contributes to the organization’s digital transformation initiatives.

Why this role is important:

You are responsible for leading and evolving the organizations ability to drive revenue through the creation and maintenance of innovative ad products and services.
You are responsible for developing a strategic roadmap that aligns to the strategic priorities of the Media Solutions (Sales) team, by identifying and executing on the highest priorities.
You enable the evolution of ad formats, the integration of technologies within the ad tech stack, the evolution of the data strategy and the enablement of key features and improvements for our users.
You establish a testing practice that is continuously finding ways to improve the existing ad experience with new ad loads, scenarios by user type and ad formats to adopt.
You are in lock step with the strategy of the Media Solutions team. The products that your teams develop are relevant in the market and sellable.
You enable real collaboration between your stakeholders and the product teams focusing them on solving problems together.
You are the main point of accountability and escalation to Media Solutions as it relates to product development.
You coach and mentor a cross functional team of product managers, data analysts and data experts.

Core Competencies / Mindset:

This role requires a proactive and collaborative leader who acts as a crucial link between technical possibilities and business needs:

Problem Solver & Roadblock Remover: key to understanding what is possible, navigating the entire team around roadblocks, and creating options and alternatives to respond to business problems
Collaborative Leader: creates a positive and collaborative space that fosters deeper understanding between supported teams, often by facilitating meetings as forums for problem-solving
Clarity & Accountability: key to creating clarity on the roadmap, ensuring decisions are made, and escalating effectively to clear the path on execution
Efficiency Driver: focused on making things easier, faster, smoother, and better, including filling gaps personally with conversations and trackers, and coaching resources on performance
Client Service Mindset: sets high standards, seeks out feedback, acts on it, and ensures teams are serving stakeholders appropriately
Action-Oriented & Transparent: strongly biased towards action, pushing for ways forward with personal involvement over passing the buck. Works transparently, ensuring risks are appropriately distributed across all decision makers rather than made in silos
Product Leader: reinforces basic product principles, helps teams find effective ways forward, emphasizing the quest for value over increments of work

How you will make an impact:

You will work closely with your partners in Media Solutions - from Ad Tech, Ad Operations and Data Monetization to understand their needs to deepen the nature of the relationship. You will invest the time in understanding their strategic roadmaps and the most important problems to solve.
You will work closely with a team of product managers to ensure that roadmaps reflect the priorities and needs of the stakeholders and you will make sure the teams are focused on the right things. You will make sure that the product teams are delivering real value to your stakeholders.
You will enable the generation of revenue through the activation of audiences first party data.

Candidate Qualifications:

Minimum of five to seven (5 to 7) years of progressive leadership within the media or advertising industry
Deep expertise in advertising, digital transformation, and multi-platform consumer behaviour
Demonstrated adaptability in dynamic environments with the resilience to navigate ambiguity and lead organizational change
Exceptional communication and presentation skills; bilingual proficiency in French and English is highly desirable
Superior relationship management skills with a proven ability to influence senior executives through diplomacy and strategic negotiation
Ability to manage competing priorities and high-pressure deadlines with operational excellence

Candidates may be subject to skills and knowledge testing.

We thank all applicants for their interest, but only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates who advance to the next

step will be asked to complete a background check. This includes:

A mandatory Criminal record check.
Other background checks may be conducted based on the operational requirements of the position.

CBC/Radio-Canada is committed to being a leader in reflecting our country’s diversity. That’s because we can only create and tell the stories that connect Canadians, by having a workforce that mirrors the ever-changing makeup of our country. That’s why we, as an employer, value equal opportunity and nurture an inclusive workplace where our individual differences are not only recognized and valued, but also extend to and pervade all the services we provide as Canada’s public broadcaster. For more information, visit the Diversity and Inclusion section of our website. If you have accommodation needs at this stage of the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible by sending an e-mail to recruitment@cbc.ca.

You are invited to consult and familiarize yourself with our Code of Conduct, which can be found on our corporate website. All employees must adhere to the Code as a condition of employment. We also invite you to take a look at our policy on conflicts of interest. In the event that you become an employee, it will be important to inform us, as quickly as possible, of any situation that, because of your hiring, constitutes or could appear to constitute a conflict of interest.

jobs.description:
Salary range:

Why choose us

There is more to Pension Corporation than you might think. We are an award-winning organization with meaningful purpose-driven work, where staff have impact and create peace of mind for those we serve. We have cultivated an outstanding community rooted in respect, where employees are inspired to have courage, take action, and be at their best every day.
Our nine-year strategic plan, Plan 20|30: Our Future is Insight , will guide us from 2021 to 2030. To learn about our aspirations and objectives and how you can be a part of a people-focused organization that is grounded in operational excellence, visit bcpensioncorp.ca.

What we offer

Comprehensive extended health and dental benefits for you and your family
Defined benefit pension program
Health & wellness programs - lunchtime seminars, community activities and a comprehensive Employee & Family Assistance Program
Incredible campus with collaboration spaces, sit/stand desks, and lots of natural light
Ongoing training, professional development opportunities, and scholarship programs
Opportunities to give back to the community and support not-for-profits
Seasonal events and socials
A robust awards/recognition program
Discounts on BC Transit passes, travel and accommodation, cell phones and plans, and more

Hybrid Work Model

This position is located in our Victoria, BC office. You will have the flexibility to work part of the time on-campus and part of the time off-campus. The requirement for on-campus presence is a minimum of 40% of your schedule in a month.
Additional requirements are determined by the role functions and operational needs of each business area.

We are seeking an Assistant Director, Digital Experience and Communication Services
to join our team in VICTORIA, British Columbia, Canada.

Step into a leadership role where you can shape the future of our member experience.
As we prepare for Wave 3, you’ll help lead the development of new pension plan websites and bring our Member Experience and Engagement Strategy to life, creating simpler, more intuitive and engaging experiences.

Working closely with the Director, Member Services and Experience, you’ll lead and empower managers and professional staff across digital products, user experience, content, education, forms and correspondence. You’ll set direction, align priorities, manage budgets and resources, and turn strategy into meaningful results for members and employers.

Qualifications

Must have

Degree in communications, digital media, user experience, business administration, public administration, marketing, or related discipline.
Five years of progressive experience in digital experience, communications, user experience, product management or a related service environment including:
Managing digital products, services, or portfolios throughout their lifecycle.
Supervising professional or cross-functional teams, including assigning work, coaching, supporting development, and managing performance.
Leading cross-functional initiative, digital transformation, emerging technology adoption and service improvements.
Managing operations, budgets, resources, competing priorities, risks, vendors, and service commitments.
Developing and implementing business plans, strategies, governance, quality standards, and evidence-based performance improvements.
Building relationships and providing strategic advice to senior leaders and partners.
An equivalent combination of related education, training, and experience may be considered.

Nice to have:

Experience overseeing website modernization and digital platform delivery.
Working with technology partners on content and communications platforms, authenticated services and integrations.
Experience with digital product roadmaps, using research and analytics to improve member or customer experiences.
Experience overseeing correspondence, forms and structured content.
Working in pensions, financial services, insurance, government or other regulated environments.

To learn more about the Assistant Director, Digital Experience and Communication Services
position and to apply, please visit our website: Assistant Director, Digital Experience and Communication Services - BC Pensions Career Site Careers

We thank you for your interest in working with us. You will be informed of your status in this competition as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer
jobs.description:
Wag & Bright Supply Co.

Calgary, Alberta | Hybrid | Full-Time

Help us build what comes next.

Wag & Bright is a growing Canadian pet care company behind Puppy Polish and Mighty Marrows. We’re founder-led, ambitious, and looking for a financial leader who is excited to help build the business alongside us.

Our team is lean, our work is hands-on, and we’re building the systems and processes to support our next stage of growth.

We’re looking for a commercially minded CFO with an entrepreneurial mindset, strong technical accounting skills, and the resourcefulness to turn plans into action. Someone who sees a challenge, takes ownership, and helps find a way forward.

The opportunity

Working directly with the CEO and COO, you’ll lead financial planning, reporting, cash flow management and the development of our finance function.

This role combines strategy with execution. You should be equally comfortable discussing a growth opportunity, building a financial model, investigating a margin discrepancy, or helping the accounting team improve a process. You won’t need every system to be perfectly established before you can contribute. You’ll help us decide what needs building, what needs improving, and what can stay simple.

What you’ll own

Financial planning and cash flow. Lead budgets, rolling forecasts and financial modelling, giving leadership clear visibility into performance, working capital and future requirements.
Accounting and reporting. Take responsibility for accurate, timely financial reporting and strong controls, working with our accounting team and external advisors.
Costing and profitability. Improve visibility into product costs, inventory, margins and profitability across our sales channels. Help translate those insights into better pricing and operational decisions.
Systems and processes. Build practical reporting tools, improve workflows and introduce automation where it genuinely saves time or improves accuracy.
Commercial decision support. Help evaluate business opportunities, spending priorities, capital requirements and the financial implications of growth.
Financial leadership. Guide and develop the accounting function, coordinate with financial service providers, and oversee compliance and payroll processes.

Who will thrive here

We’re looking for someone who brings:
A strong finance foundation. Senior experience as a CFO, Finance Director, VP Finance or Controller, with hands-on expertise in accounting, forecasting and financial modelling. A CPA designation is strongly preferred.
Relevant business experience. An understanding of b2b, d2c, inventory, product costing and working capital, ideally gained in consumer products, manufacturing, wholesale, distribution or e-commerce.
An entrepreneurial mindset. You understand how to work with a lean team, prioritise limited resources and build practical solutions without unnecessary complexity.
Resilience and ownership. You’re comfortable with changing priorities, raise concerns early, and bring recommendations - not just a list of problems.
Clear communication and sound judgment. You can explain the numbers, challenge assumptions constructively, and work closely with founders and colleagues who aren’t finance specialists.
Strong Excel and financial modelling skills are essential. Experience with QuickBooks Online and improving financial systems is valuable.

You may already be a CFO, or you may be an accomplished Controller or Finance Director ready for broader responsibility. What matters most is your capability, your approach, and your enthusiasm for this stage of the business.

Why join us?

This is an opportunity to have a direct impact on how a growing company operates and what it becomes.

You’ll work closely with the founders, have a voice in important decisions, and help build a finance function that supports both day-to-day execution and long-term ambitions.

We’re looking for someone who is genuinely keen to take the journey with us- someone who cares about the business, takes pride in their work, and wants to help build something meaningful over time.

To apply

Please submit your résumé and a brief note about why joining a founder-led company at this stage appeals to you.

One last thing… 🐾

Tell us your pet’s name and what you love most about them! We’d love to get to know the person behind the résumé.
